CVE™ Program - LinkML Schema

  • Auto-generated schema documentation

docs.title: About cve
docs.text: A LinkML schema for the CVE Record Format v5.2.0, the canonical exchange format for entries in the CVE™ Program.

docs.title: Goals
docs.text:
• Faithfully model every required and optional field of the upstream JSON Schema so that every official CVE Record validates without loss.
  • Provide a single source of truth from which idiomatic artifacts are generated for downstream consumers (Python dataclasses + Pydantic, JSON Schema, JSON-LD context, GraphQL, Protobuf, SHACL/ShEx, SQL DDL, OWL/TTL, TypeScript, Java, Excel).
  • Bridge the CVE record format with adjacent vulnerability schemas (KEV Catalog, CWE, NIST NVD) through a small shared core, mappings, and semantic vocabularies (Wikidata, schema.org, Dublin Core, SKOS).
  • Stay close to the spec: identifier patterns (CVE-YYYY-N{4,19}), enum permissible values, and cardinality match upstream verbatim; field names use snake_case slots with camelCase aliases: for JSON interop.

docs.title: High-level structure
docs.text:
A CVE Record (CVERecord) is a wrapper document with four top-level fields:

Field Type Notes dataType constant CVE_RECORD Record kind discriminator dataVersion constant 5.2.0 Format version cveMetadata CveMetadata (abstract) Published or Rejected metadata containers Containers One CNA container + optional ADP containers

The CNA and metadata branches are modelled as abstract bases with concrete subclasses, exposed to consumers via slot-level any_of:

classDiagram
    class CVERecord
    class CveMetadata { <<abstract>> }
    class CveMetadataPublished
    class CveMetadataRejected
    class Containers
    class CnaContainer { <<abstract>> }
    class CnaPublishedContainer
    class CnaRejectedContainer
    class AdpContainer

    CVERecord --> CveMetadata : cveMetadata
    CVERecord --> Containers : containers
    CveMetadata <|-- CveMetadataPublished
    CveMetadata <|-- CveMetadataRejected
    Containers --> CnaContainer : cna
    Containers --> "0..*" AdpContainer : adp
    CnaContainer <|-- CnaPublishedContainer
    CnaContainer <|-- CnaRejectedContainer

State is the discriminator: cveMetadata.state == PUBLISHED selects the *Published shapes; REJECTED selects the *Rejected shapes.

docs.title: 1. Snake-case slots with camelCase aliases
docs.text: Upstream JSON uses camelCase (cveMetadata, dataPublished, cpeApplicability, …). The schema declares snake_case slot names (LinkML convention) and adds the upstream key as a aliases: entry. Generated JSON Schema accepts the camelCase form; the tests/test_third_party.py translator uses the alias map to consume vendor JSON without manual rewriting.

docs.title: 2. Polymorphism via subclasses, not union_of
docs.text:
CveMetadata and CnaContainer are abstract with two concrete subclasses each. The discriminator (state) lives on the subclasses; consumers pick the right shape with slot-level any_of:

cve_metadata:
  range: CveMetadata
  any_of:
    - range: CveMetadataPublished
    - range: CveMetadataRejected

This is the workaround for an issue (gen-json-schema emits {} instead of oneOf for class-level union_of). The slot-level any_of produces a clean anyOf in the generated JSON Schema while still letting gen-python / gen-pydantic materialise both concrete classes.

docs.title: 3. CVERecord is not an is_a Vulnerability
docs.text:
vulnerability_core.Vulnerability declares cve_id as identifier: true, required: true — correct for the vulnerability entity, wrong for the document that wraps one. The CVE Record places its ID at cveMetadata.cveId, not at the root.

Per the LinkML metamodel, identifiers cannot be optional, so slot_usage: { cve_id: { required: false } } is intentionally a no-op. The schema therefore expresses semantic equivalence via exact_mappings instead of is_a:

CVERecord:
  tree_root: true
  exact_mappings:
    - WIKIDATA:Q631425
    - core:Vulnerability

The same reasoning applies to AffectedProduct vs core:Product.

docs.title: 4. CVSS metrics: one class per major version
docs.text: CvssV4_0, CvssV3 (covers 3.0 and 3.1 via a cvss3_version discriminator), and CvssV2_0 are first-class types. A MetricEntry references one of them through optional slots plus a top-level format discriminator that matches upstream behaviour. Non-standard scoring (e.g. SSVC) is captured via OtherMetric.content typed as Any, faithful to the upstream "free-form proprietary payload" semantics.

docs.title: 5. Conditional cardinality
docs.text:
Several upstream invariants are expressed with LinkML's boolean slot conditions, e.g. on AffectedProduct:

all_of:
  - any_of:
      - slot_conditions: { vendor: { required: true }, name: { required: true } }
      - slot_conditions: { collection_url: { required: true }, package_name: { required: true } }
  - any_of:
      - slot_conditions: { versions:        { required: true } }
      - slot_conditions: { default_status:  { required: true } }

These translate to JSON-Schema allOf/anyOf blocks that reproduce the upstream "at least one of vendor+product or collectionURL+packageName" rules without scripting.

docs.title: 6. String-length bounds via annotations
docs.text:
LinkML's core metamodel lacks first-class min_length / max_length. For interop fidelity, string slots that have explicit upstream bounds carry annotations:

description_value:
  range: string
  annotations:
    min_length: 1
    max_length: 4096

gen-owl surfaces these as XSD facets; other generators ignore them today but the data is captured for future generator support.

docs.title: 7. Mapping vocabularies
docs.text:
Each concept is annotated with mappings to:

  • Wikidata (WIKIDATA:Q631425 for Vulnerability)
  • schema.org (schema:SoftwareApplication for affected products)
  • Dublin Core Terms (dcterms:title, dcterms:description, etc.)
  • SKOS, RDFS for taxonomic relationships
  • Sibling schemas: nvd:NVDEntry, cwe:Weakness, kev_catalog:KevEntry

SSSOM tables in src/cve/mappings/ provide row-level mappings to CWE, KEV, and NVD entries.

docs.title: Validation strategy
docs.text:
Three independent checks gate every change:

  1. just lint — linkml-lint against the configured ruleset (.linkmllint.yaml).
  2. just gen-project — all generators must succeed and produce the artefacts under project/.
  3. just test — pytest runs three suites:
  4. tests/test_data.py validates curated valid / invalid fixtures.
  5. tests/test_third_party.py validates the 13 official upstream example records under tests/data/third_party/cveschema/.
  6. Pydantic roundtrip checks ensure no upstream field is silently dropped.

docs.title: Class: VersionEntry
docs.text: A single version or a range of versions of a product with associated vulnerability status. An entry with only version and status is a point version; an entry with versionType and a less-than limit describes a range.

docs.title: Induced
docs.text:
name: VersionEntry
description: A single version or a range of versions of a product with associated
  vulnerability status. An entry with only version and status is a point version;
  an entry with versionType and a less-than limit describes a range.
from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/cve
slot_usage:
  version_value:
    name: version_value
    required: true
  version_status:
    name: version_status
    required: true
attributes:
  version_value:
    name: version_value
    description: The single version being described, or the version at the start of
      the range. By convention, '0' denotes the earliest possible version.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/cve
    aliases:
    - version
    rank: 1000
    owner: VersionEntry
    domain_of:
    - VersionEntry
    range: VersionString
    required: true
  version_status:
    name: version_status
    description: The vulnerability status for the version or range of versions. For
      a range, the status may be refined by the 'changes' list.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/cve
    aliases:
    - status
    rank: 1000
    owner: VersionEntry
    domain_of:
    - VersionEntry
    range: VersionStatus
    required: true
  version_type:
    name: version_type
    annotations:
      min_length:
        tag: min_length
        value: 1
      max_length:
        tag: max_length
        value: 128
    description: The version numbering system used for specifying the range (e.g.,
      semver, git, maven, rpm, python, custom). Defines the semantics of comparison.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/cve
    aliases:
    - versionType
    rank: 1000
    owner: VersionEntry
    domain_of:
    - VersionEntry
    range: string
  less_than:
    name: less_than
    description: The non-inclusive upper limit of the range. This is the least version
      NOT in the range. Supports wildcard '*' suffix.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/cve
    aliases:
    - lessThan
    rank: 1000
    owner: VersionEntry
    domain_of:
    - VersionEntry
    range: VersionString
  less_than_or_equal:
    name: less_than_or_equal
    description: The inclusive upper limit of the range. This is the greatest version
      contained in the range. Only one of lessThan and lessThanOrEqual should be specified.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/cve
    aliases:
    - lessThanOrEqual
    rank: 1000
    owner: VersionEntry
    domain_of:
    - VersionEntry
    range: VersionString
  version_changes:
    name: version_changes
    description: A list of status changes that take place during the version range.
      The array should be sorted by 'at' field according to versionType, but clients
      must re-sort rather than assume ordering.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/lmodel/cve
    aliases:
    - changes
    rank: 1000
    owner: VersionEntry
    domain_of:
    - VersionEntry
    range: VersionChange
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
rules:
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      less_than:
        name: less_than
        required: true
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      version_type:
        name: version_type
        required: true
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      less_than_or_equal:
        name: less_than_or_equal
        required: true
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      version_type:
        name: version_type
        required: true
none_of:
- slot_conditions:
    less_than:
      name: less_than
      required: true
    less_than_or_equal:
      name: less_than_or_equal
      required: true

docs.title: Slot: adp
docs.text: One or more ADP containers providing additional vulnerability information. Multiple ADPs may contribute containers for the same CVE ID.

docs.title: Slot: adp_tags
docs.text: Tags provided by an ADP describing the CVE Record.

docs.title: Slot: affected
docs.text: List of affected products and services.

docs.title: Slot: assigner_org_id
docs.text: The UUID for the organization to which the CVE ID was originally assigned. This UUID can be used to lookup the organization record in the user registry service.

docs.title: Slot: assigner_short_name
docs.text: The short name for the organization to which the CVE ID was originally assigned.

docs.title: Slot: base64_encoded
docs.text: If true, the media_value field contains the media data encoded in base64. If false, the media_value field contains UTF-8 media content.

docs.title: Slot: capec_id
docs.text: CAPEC ID that best relates to this impact (e.g., CAPEC-123).

docs.title: Slot: change_at
docs.text: The version at which a status change occurs within a range.

docs.title: Slot: change_status
docs.text: The new status in the range starting at the given version.

docs.title: Slot: cna
docs.text: The CNA container holding vulnerability information for this CVE ID. For published records, this is a CnaPublishedContainer. For rejected records, this is a CnaRejectedContainer.

docs.title: Slot: cna_source
docs.text: Source information (who discovered it, who researched it, etc.) and optionally a chain of CNA information.

docs.title: Slot: cna_tags
docs.text: Tags provided by a CNA describing the CVE Record.

docs.title: Slot: collection_url
docs.text: URL identifying a package collection (determines the meaning of packageName).

docs.title: Slot: configurations_text
docs.text: Configurations required for exploiting this vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: containers
docs.text: A set of containers (CNA and optionally ADP) holding vulnerability information related to the CVE ID.

docs.title: Slot: cpe_applicability
docs.text: Affected products defined using the CPE Applicability Language. When defined, this block should align with the data in the affected block.

docs.title: Slot: cpe_criteria
docs.text: CPE 2.3 formatted name match string or match criteria.

docs.title: Slot: cpe_match_criteria
docs.text: Array of CPE match criteria within this node.

docs.title: Slot: cpe_negate
docs.text: If true, negates the applicability of this element.

docs.title: Slot: cpe_nodes
docs.text: Array of CPE configuration nodes.

docs.title: Slot: cpe_operator
docs.text: Logical operator (AND/OR) used between CPE criteria in this node.

docs.title: Slot: cpe_uri
docs.text: CPE 2.2 URI identifying an affected product configuration.

docs.title: Slot: cpe_vulnerable
docs.text: Whether this CPE match describes a vulnerable configuration.

docs.title: Slot: cpes
docs.text: Affected products defined by CPE (Common Platform Enumeration) names in either 2.2 or 2.3 format.

docs.title: Slot: credit_type
docs.text: Type or role of the entity being credited.

docs.title: Slot: credit_user
docs.text: UUID of the user being credited, if present in the CVE User Registry. This UUID can be used to lookup the user record in the user registry service.

docs.title: Slot: credit_value
docs.text: The name or description of the credited party (up to 4096 characters).

docs.title: Slot: credits
docs.text: Statements acknowledging specific people, organizations, or tools for work related to research, discovery, remediation, or coordination of this CVE.

docs.title: cve
docs.text:
Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE™) Program - LinkML Schema. Provides complete semantic coverage of the CVE Record Format v5 JSON Schema, including published and rejected records, all container types, CVSS 4.0/3.1/3.0/2.0 scoring, CPE applicability, taxonomy mappings, credits, and timeline entries.

URI: https://w3id.org/lmodel/cve

docs.title: Slot: cve_id
docs.text: The CVE identifier assigned by a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA). Format: CVE-YYYY-NNNNN.

docs.title: Slot: cve_metadata
docs.text: Metadata about the CVE ID. A Published record uses CveMetadataPublished; a Rejected record uses CveMetadataRejected.

docs.title: Slot: cve_references
docs.text: Reference data in the form of URLs describing the vulnerability, such as advisories, patches, and exploit details. Required by CNA rules.

docs.title: Slot: cvss2_base_score
docs.text: CVSS 2.0 base score (0.0 – 10.0).

docs.title: Slot: cvss2_environmental_score
docs.text: CVSS 2.0 environmental score.

docs.title: Slot: cvss2_temporal_score
docs.text: CVSS 2.0 temporal score.

docs.title: Slot: cvss2_vector_string
docs.text: CVSS 2.0 vector string encoding all base, temporal, and environmental metrics.

docs.title: Slot: cvss2_version
docs.text: CVSS version identifier. Must be '2.0' for CVSS v2.0 objects.

docs.title: Slot: cvss3_base_score
docs.text: CVSS 3.x base score (0.0 – 10.0 in 0.1 increments).

docs.title: Slot: cvss3_environmental_score
docs.text: CVSS 3.x environmental score.

docs.title: Slot: cvss3_temporal_score
docs.text: CVSS 3.x temporal score.

docs.title: Slot: cvss3_vector_string
docs.text: CVSS 3.x vector string encoding all metric values. CVSS 3.1 strings begin with 'CVSS:3.1/'; CVSS 3.0 strings begin with 'CVSS:3.0/'.

docs.title: Slot: cvss3_version
docs.text: CVSS version identifier ('3.0' or '3.1') within a CvssV3 object.

docs.title: Slot: cvss4_base_score
docs.text: CVSS 4.0 base score (0.0 – 10.0 in 0.1 increments).

docs.title: Slot: cvss4_base_severity
docs.text: CVSS 4.0 qualitative base severity rating.

docs.title: Slot: cvss4_vector_string
docs.text: CVSS 4.0 vector string encoding all base, threat, and environmental metrics.

docs.title: Slot: cvss4_version
docs.text: CVSS version identifier. Must be '4.0' for CVSS v4.0 objects.

docs.title: Slot: cvss_v2_0
docs.text: CVSS version 2.0 scoring data.

docs.title: Slot: cvss_v3
docs.text: CVSS version 3.x scoring data (covers both 3.0 and 3.1). The version is distinguished by the cvss3_version field within the CvssV3 object.

docs.title: Slot: cvss_v4_0
docs.text: CVSS version 4.0 scoring data.

docs.title: Slot: cwe_id
docs.text: CWE identifier for the weakness classification (e.g. CWE-79).

docs.title: Slot: data_type
docs.text: Indicates the type of information represented in the JSON instance.

docs.title: Slot: data_version
docs.text: The version of the CVE schema used for validating this record. Supports multiple versions of the format (e.g., '5.2.0').

docs.title: Slot: date_assigned
docs.text: The date/time this CVE ID was associated with a vulnerability by a CNA.

docs.title: Slot: date_public
docs.text: If known, the date/time the vulnerability was disclosed publicly.

docs.title: Slot: date_published
docs.text: The date/time the CVE Record was first published in the CVE List.

docs.title: Slot: date_rejected
docs.text: The date/time the CVE ID was rejected.

docs.title: Slot: date_reserved
docs.text: The date/time this CVE ID was reserved in the CVE automation workgroup services system. This date does not necessarily indicate when the vulnerability was discovered, shared with the vendor, or publicly disclosed.

docs.title: Slot: date_updated
docs.text: The date/time the record was last updated.

docs.title: Slot: default_status
docs.text: The default status for versions not otherwise listed in the versions list. Defaults to 'unknown' if not specified. Versions or defaultStatus may be omitted, but not both.

docs.title: Slot: description
docs.text: Narrative description of the vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: description_value
docs.text: Plain text description (up to 4096 characters).

docs.title: Slot: descriptions
docs.text: A list of multi-lingual descriptions of the vulnerability. Must contain at least one English language entry. E.g., [PROBLEMTYPE] in [COMPONENT] in [VENDOR] [PRODUCT] [VERSION] on [PLATFORMS] allows [ATTACKER] to [IMPACT] via [VECTOR].

docs.title: Slot: event_time
docs.text: Timestamp representing when the event in the timeline occurred. Format is RFC3339 / ISO8601 with optional timezone.

docs.title: Slot: event_value
docs.text: A summary of the timeline event (up to 4096 characters).

docs.title: Slot: exploits
docs.text: Information about known exploits of this vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: impact
docs.text: Impact and severity assessment for this vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: impact_descriptions
docs.text: Prose description of the impact scenario. At a minimum, provide the description given by CAPEC.

docs.title: Slot: impacts
docs.text: Collection of impacts of this vulnerability, optionally linked to CAPEC IDs.

docs.title: Slot: lang
docs.text: BCP 47 language code indicating the language of accompanying text.

docs.title: Slot: last_modified_date
docs.text: Date and time the vulnerability record was last modified.

docs.title: Slot: less_than
docs.text: The non-inclusive upper limit of the range. This is the least version NOT in the range. Supports wildcard '*' suffix.

docs.title: Slot: less_than_or_equal
docs.text: The inclusive upper limit of the range. This is the greatest version contained in the range. Only one of lessThan and lessThanOrEqual should be specified.

docs.title: Slot: match_criteria_id
docs.text: UUID identifying the CPE match criteria set.

docs.title: Slot: media_type
docs.text: RFC2046 compliant IANA Media type (e.g., text/markdown, text/html, image/png, image/svg, audio/mp3).

docs.title: Slot: media_value
docs.text: Supporting media content, up to 16K characters. If base64_encoded is true, this stores base64 encoded data.

docs.title: Slot: metric_format
docs.text: Name of the scoring format (e.g., cvssV4_0, cvssV3_1). Provides future-proofing and supports proprietary format inclusion.

docs.title: Slot: metric_scenarios
docs.text: Scenarios this metrics object applies to. If no specific scenario is given, GENERAL applies when no more specific metric matches.

docs.title: Slot: metrics
docs.text: Collection of impact scores with attribution (CVSSv2, CVSSv3.0, CVSSv3.1, CVSSv4.0, or custom format).

docs.title: Slot: modules
docs.text: A list of the affected components, features, modules, sub-components, sub-products, APIs, commands, utilities, programs, or functionalities.

docs.title: Slot: name
docs.text: Name of the entity (product, weakness, reference, etc.).

docs.title: Slot: operator
docs.text: Logical operator (AND/OR) used in configuration node groupings.

docs.title: Slot: org_id
docs.text: The container provider's organizational UUID.

docs.title: Slot: other_metric
docs.text: A non-standard impact description or score.

docs.title: Slot: other_metric_content
docs.text: Arbitrary JSON-compatible object (or prose string) containing non-standard metric data not covered by the CVSS formats. Upstream JSON Schema defines this as 'type: object, minProperties: 1'; range: Any allows any value.

docs.title: Slot: other_metric_type
docs.text: Name of the non-standard impact metrics format used.

docs.title: Slot: package_name
docs.text: Name or identifier of the affected software package as used in the package collection.

docs.title: Slot: package_url
docs.text: A Package URL (PURL), a unified URL specification for identifying packages hosted by known package hosts. The Package URL MUST NOT include a version.

docs.title: Slot: platforms
docs.text: Platforms or operating environments affected.

docs.title: Slot: problem_description
docs.text: Text description of the problem type, or title from CWE or OWASP.

docs.title: Slot: problem_references
docs.text: References supporting this specific problem type.

docs.title: Slot: problem_source_type
docs.text: Problem type source format (e.g., text, OWASP, CWE).

docs.title: Slot: problem_type_descriptions
docs.text: One or more problem type descriptions (e.g., CWE IDs or OWASP categories).

docs.title: Slot: problem_types
docs.text: Problem type information such as CWE identifiers. Must contain at least one entry. Entries can be text, OWASP, or CWE identifiers.

docs.title: Slot: products
docs.text: Products affected by this vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: program_files
docs.text: A list of the affected source code files.

docs.title: Slot: program_routines
docs.text: A list of the affected source code functions, methods, subroutines, or procedures.

docs.title: Slot: provider_metadata
docs.text: Details related to the information container provider (CNA or ADP).

docs.title: Slot: published_date
docs.text: Date and time the vulnerability was first published.

docs.title: Slot: published_state
docs.text: State of the CVE Record. For published records, this is always PUBLISHED.

docs.title: Slot: record_cve_id
docs.text: The CVE identifier that this record pertains to.

docs.title: Slot: reference_tags
docs.text: An array of tags describing the resource referenced by the URL.

docs.title: Slot: references
docs.text: External references such as advisories and articles.

docs.title: Slot: rejected_reasons
docs.text: Reasons for rejecting this CVE Record.

docs.title: Slot: rejected_state
docs.text: State of the CVE Record. For rejected records, this is always REJECTED.

docs.title: Slot: relationship_name
docs.text: A description of the relationship between the taxonomy item and the CVE.

docs.title: Slot: relationship_value
docs.text: The target of the relationship. Can be the CVE ID or another taxonomy identifier.

docs.title: Slot: replaced_by
docs.text: CVE IDs that this CVE ID was rejected in favor of because this CVE ID was incorrectly assigned to the same vulnerabilities.

docs.title: Slot: repo
docs.text: The URL of the source code repository, for informational purposes and/or to resolve git hash version ranges.

docs.title: Slot: requester_user_id
docs.text: The user that requested the CVE identifier.

docs.title: Slot: routine_name
docs.text: Name of the affected source code function, method, subroutine, or procedure.

docs.title: Slot: scenario_value
docs.text: Description of the scenario this metrics object applies to.

docs.title: Slot: score
docs.text: Numeric vulnerability score (e.g. CVSS base score).

docs.title: Slot: serial
docs.text: Monotonically increasing integer, starting at 1, incremented each time a submission from a data provider changes this CVE Record.

docs.title: Slot: severity
docs.text: Qualitative severity rating.

docs.title: Slot: short_name
docs.text: The container provider's organizational short name (2-32 characters).

docs.title: Slot: solutions
docs.text: Information about solutions or remediations available for this vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: source
docs.text: Source or origin of the reference or data.

docs.title: Slot: source_advisory
docs.text: Advisory identifier associated with the vulnerability discovery.

docs.title: Slot: source_defects
docs.text: Bug tracking system IDs (e.g., JIRA ticket IDs) related to the vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: source_discovery
docs.text: How the vulnerability was discovered (e.g., INTERNAL, EXTERNAL, USER).

docs.title: Slot: status
docs.text: Current lifecycle state of the vulnerability record.

docs.title: Slot: supporting_media
docs.text: Supporting media data for the description such as markdown, diagrams, etc. Similar to RFC 2397, each object has a media type, data value, and optional base64 flag.

docs.title: Slot: taxonomy_id
docs.text: Identifier of the item in the taxonomy. Used as the subject of the relationship.

docs.title: Slot: taxonomy_mappings
docs.text: List of taxonomy items (e.g., ATT&CK, CWE) related to the vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: taxonomy_name
docs.text: The name of the taxonomy (e.g., ATT&CK, D3FEND, CWE, CVSS).

docs.title: Slot: taxonomy_relations
docs.text: List of relationships to the taxonomy for this vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: taxonomy_version
docs.text: The version of the taxonomy the identifiers come from.

docs.title: Slot: timeline
docs.text: Timeline information for significant events about the vulnerability or changes to the CVE Record.

docs.title: Slot: title
docs.text: Short human-readable title or name for this entity.

docs.title: Slot: url
docs.text: URL pointing to the reference resource.

docs.title: Slot: vector
docs.text: CVSS vector string or equivalent scoring vector expression.

docs.title: Slot: vendor
docs.text: Name of the vendor or organization responsible for the product.

docs.title: Slot: version
docs.text: Version string of the affected product.

docs.title: Slot: version_changes
docs.text: A list of status changes that take place during the version range. The array should be sorted by 'at' field according to versionType, but clients must re-sort rather than assume ordering.

docs.title: Slot: version_end_excluding
docs.text: The end of a version range, exclusive (versions strictly less than this).

docs.title: Slot: version_end_including
docs.text: The end of a version range, inclusive (versions less than or equal to this).

docs.title: Slot: version_start_excluding
docs.text: The start of a version range, exclusive (versions strictly greater than this).

docs.title: Slot: version_start_including
docs.text: The start of a version range, inclusive (versions greater than or equal to this).

docs.title: Slot: version_status
docs.text: The vulnerability status for the version or range of versions. For a range, the status may be refined by the 'changes' list.

docs.title: Slot: version_type
docs.text: The version numbering system used for specifying the range (e.g., semver, git, maven, rpm, python, custom). Defines the semantics of comparison.

docs.title: Slot: version_value
docs.text: The single version being described, or the version at the start of the range. By convention, '0' denotes the earliest possible version.

docs.title: Slot: versions
docs.text: Set of product versions or version ranges related to the vulnerability. Versions or defaultStatus may be omitted, but not both.

docs.title: Slot: weaknesses
docs.text: Weakness classifications (e.g. CWE) associated with this vulnerability.

docs.title: Slot: workarounds
docs.text: Workarounds and mitigations for this vulnerability.
